**sdd/issue-606-rollup-reports-its-cause/apply-progress**

**What**: Implemented issue #606 end-to-end (all 10 phases of tasks.md except 9.1, filing the follow-up issue, deliberately deferred to the orchestrator). `prStatusRollup` (github.mjs + gitlab.mjs) now returns a frozen `{uncomputable, reason, detail}` shape on every failure path instead of bare `null`; a new pure module `vcs/lib/uncomputable-cause.mjs` is the single constructor + ordered classifier; `tranche.mjs`'s `evaluateTranche` renders the cause in `conditions` without changing the `REVISE` verdict.

**Why**: `brain-issue-606` worktree, branch `fix/issue-606-fixvcs-prstatusrollup-swallows-the-cause`. Orchestrator-assigned SDD apply for change `issue-606-rollup-reports-its-cause`, artifact store hybrid (openspec files + engram). STRICT TDD MODE active throughout.

**Where**:
- New: `brain/scripts/vcs/lib/uncomputable-cause.mjs`, `brain/scripts/vcs/lib/uncomputable-cause.test.mjs`
- Modified: `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/github.mjs`, `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/gitlab.mjs`, `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/vcs.contract.test.mjs`, `brain/scripts/review/evaluators/tranche.mjs`, `brain/scripts/review/evaluators/tranche.test.mjs`, `brain/scripts/brain-metrics.test.mjs`, `brain/core/methodology/vcs-contract.md`
- SDD artifacts: `openspec/changes/issue-606-rollup-reports-its-cause/{proposal,spec,design,tasks}.md` — tasks.md has every checkbox `[x]` except 9.1.
- 7 conventional-commit work units on the branch, all referencing #606, no AI-attribution trailers, `npm run brain:repo:check` passed before every commit.

**Learned**:
- **Corpus provenance violation caught and fixed mid-session**: initial corpus rows were transcribed from design.md's own prose examples, not independently verified — this violated the hard constraint. Re-verified everything against a real `gh 2.46.0` binary (`gh` IS installed; `glab` is genuinely absent). Found: (1) `exec.mjs` uses `spawnSync`, so the real ENOENT text is `spawnSync <cmd> ENOENT`, not `spawn <cmd> ENOENT` as design.md's own comment claimed; (2) `gh`'s real "Bad credentials"/"gh auth login" messages differ from hand-typed versions (double-space after colon, extra lines); (3) `gitlab.mjs`'s catch passes `err.message` alone, so a rejected `fetch()` yields the bare string `'fetch failed'`, never `'TypeError: fetch failed'`; (4) discovered `gh`'s real network-failure wrapper is `"error connecting to <host>"`, never a raw Go `dial tcp`/`ENOTFOUND` — added this pattern to `NETWORK_RE`, a genuine improvement over the design's original regex; (5) dropped an invented "secondary rate limit" corpus row rather than risk a real GitHub API lockout to verify it; (6) `'glab: command not found'` was never reachable through this exec.mjs (no shell invoked) — replaced with the verified `'glab: spawnSync glab ENOENT'`.
- **Source-guard test trips on JSDoc, not just code**: the "no provider source contains `uncomputable: true`" guard scans the whole file text, so my own explanatory JSDoc comments describing the return shape tripped it. Fixed by rewording docs to avoid the literal substring while keeping them accurate.
- **shipped-hostnames guard (#648) scans test-file comments too**: mentioning `githubstatus.com` in an explanatory *comment* (not just a string literal) in a shipped test file tripped the real-hostname guard. Had to reword the comment to avoid the literal domain string.
- **M11 (design §7) had no existing detector**: the contract test suite never exercised "successful fetch, non-array rollup field" — had to add a new `malformed()` fixture + test to `vcs.contract.test.mjs` (both providers) before the mutation would actually go red. This closed a real design/test-coverage gap, not just a task-list gap.
- **13-filed-sites line-number discrepancy**: `gitlab.mjs:360` in proposal.md's filed-sites list (for the follow-up issue) appears to alias into `prStatusRollup`'s own `if (!Array.isArray(statuses)) return null;` line at HEAD — i.e. the site THIS issue fixes, not a remaining sibling site. Flagged for whoever files issue 9.1 to double-check before publishing the line list.
- Full mutation battery (M1, M2, M3, M3b, M4, M5a, M5b, M6, M6b, M7, M8, M9, M10, M11) verified red-then-green by hand, including M3b (the through-the-evaluator detail-drop) and M9 (the real bare-429 PR-number trap). Verdict never moved: `evaluateTranche` still returns `REVISE` fail-closed in every mutated state tested.
- Final: 3875/3875 tests green (baseline before this change: 3821). `git status --short` clean. Truthiness audit (task 6.1) found exactly the two known production call sites (`brain-metrics.mjs:487`, `tranche.mjs`'s `gatherTrancheInputs`), both already `Array.isArray`-guarded, no other call sites found.
